methodology.inflation: Use country-level long-run CPI from a common international source where possible.
methodology.construction: Prefer city-level official residential construction index; otherwise use the most appropriate official national/regional residential construction index.
methodology.rule: Do not substitute unverified values or silently reuse Japan assumptions for overseas regions.
